requirements.title: An implicit-interface function result is typed by the function name
requirements.source: 15.4.3.8 p1 first sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p334.
requirements.definition: For a function with an implicit interface, the type and type parameters of the function result are specified by implicit or explicit type specification of the function name.

pending.implicit-typing-result-type: PENDING external function i_calc with no explicit type in caller and implicit integer initial letter; caller initializes integer sentinel -404, assigns i_calc(4), and expects exact 14 from the external body.
pending.explicit-typing-result-type: PENDING caller declares REAL r_calc and external function r_calc returning exact 2.5; real sentinel -9.0 changes to exactly 2.5 using an exactly representable value.
pending.type-parameters-from-function-name: PENDING caller declares CHARACTER(3) cfun and external CHARACTER(3) FUNCTION cfun() returning 'abc'; caller checks LEN(cfun()) equals 3 before equality with 'abc'.

requirements.oracle: Plans use exact integer, exactly representable real, and character length/value observations. Character equality is checked only after LEN.

requirements.title: Actual arguments for implicit-interface invocations are consistent with dummy characteristics
requirements.source: 15.4.3.8 p1 second sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p334.
requirements.definition: For a procedure invoked from a context where its interface is implicit, dummy argument type, type parameters, and shape must make each actual argument consistent with the corresponding dummy argument characteristics.

pending.dummy-type-consistency-control: PENDING external integer function f_int(n) with INTEGER dummy n; caller passes integer 5 initialized from sentinel -1 and expects result 15.
pending.dummy-type-parameter-consistency-control: PENDING external character function clen(s) with CHARACTER(3) dummy s; caller passes 'abc' and checks exact integer length result 3.
pending.dummy-shape-consistency-control: PENDING external function sum2(a) with explicit-shape INTEGER a(2); caller passes two-element array [4,6] and expects exact sum 10.
pending.inconsistent-actual-source-control: PENDING source-control negative changing only the actual argument from INTEGER scalar to REAL scalar in the f_int call; no required diagnostic is claimed without a separate numbered basis.

requirements.oracle: Positive controls use literal integer sums and character lengths; the source-control negative is not a diagnostic claim because this prose shall is unnumbered.
